voice: Darius (ElevenLabs eleven_v4) single take, 15 Nov 2026, atempo 1.04

lines.text: Only R271 a month for a R5,000 TV? On a store card, it costs you almost R9,750.
Thandi buys it on Black Friday, on her store card, over 36 months, at the legal maximums.
Interest at 21.25% a year: about R1,800.
The R69 monthly service fee: R2,484.
R5,000 becomes almost R9,750. About R4,750 extra, on a TV she saved R1,250 on.
Over 12 months, it's about R6,570. Better still: save first, and pay cash.
Your card may charge less, so check your statement.
The full store card guide is on the channel.
So next time you hear: only R271 a month...
